name: Microsoft 365 (Personal / Family / Basic)
notes: Researched from public support.microsoft.com articles and microsoft.com product pages only (no sign-in). Microsoft 365 consumer subscriptions are managed on the Microsoft account Services & subscriptions page. Recurring billing is the AutoPay equivalent: with it on, the subscription renews and is charged automatically; turning it off lets the subscription end at its expiration date (both online), so autopay/autopay_cancel are supported with the label 'Recurring billing'. A past-due subscription shows Pay now. Prepaid subscriptions and product keys (25 characters, renewals up to 5 years) cannot be modeled and are in help. Payment methods accepted in the US are not listed on the pages used; billing.methods ['card'] is inferred. Sign-in identifier and two-step sign-in (email, phone or Skype name, then password) are inferred from the public Microsoft account experience; mfa none because two-step verification is optional. Plans are the published US monthly prices (Basic $1.99, Personal $9.99, Family $12.99, Premium $19.99); yearly prices are in help. Monthly/yearly switch (Manage > Change > Switch) is modeled as change_plan. Subscriptions bought through Apple App Store or Google Play are canceled there.

guest_pay.note: Subscriptions are paid from your Microsoft account; there is no bill to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: With recurring billing on, your subscription renews automatically and is charged to the payment method you chose.

autopay_cancel.note: If you turn off recurring billing, you can keep using the product until the subscription expires.

paperless.note: Microsoft does not mail bills; your orders and charges are in Order history.

payment_arrangement.note: Microsoft 365 is charged each billing period and installment plans are not offered.

cancel_service.note: Subscriptions bought through the Apple App Store or Google Play are canceled with that store.

change_plan.note: Switching between monthly and yearly billing requires recurring billing to be on.

help.title: Microsoft 365 plans and prices
paragraphs: Microsoft 365 Personal is $9.99 a month or $99.99 a year. Microsoft 365 Family is $12.99 a month or $129.99 a year. Microsoft 365 Premium is $19.99 a month or $199.99 a year.
Microsoft 365 Basic is $1.99 a month or $19.99 a year. AI features are not included in Basic.

help.title: Turn recurring billing on or off
paragraphs: With recurring billing on, your subscription renews automatically and the renewal is charged to your chosen payment method; turning it on also shows what the renewal will cost.

To stop the next renewal, open Services & subscriptions, find the subscription and choose Manage. If you see Turn on recurring billing, recurring billing is already off and the subscription ends on its expiration date.
steps: Sign in and open Services & subscriptions.
Find the subscription and choose Manage.
Turn recurring billing on or off and confirm.

help.title: Renew with a product key
paragraphs: Instead of recurring billing, you can renew by redeeming a new 25-character product key from a box, card or emailed receipt. Sign in with the Microsoft account linked to your subscription, enter the key and choose your country or region; your new expiration date then appears.

Extra keys add time only, not installs or storage, and a subscription can be extended up to 5 years. To move to a prepaid code, turn off recurring billing first and redeem the code after the subscription expires.

help.title: Change how you pay
paragraphs: In Services & subscriptions, find the subscription, choose Manage, then Change how you pay. Pick a saved payment option or choose Add a new way to pay.

If Change how you pay does not appear, recurring billing is off and the subscription is already paid until it expires. Prepaid subscriptions cannot change payment method. If a balance is past due, choose Pay now.

help.title: Cancel your subscription
paragraphs: Sign in with the account you used to buy the subscription, open Services & subscriptions, choose Manage, then Cancel (or Upgrade or Cancel) and follow the prompts. You can keep using the product until the subscription expires.
If you bought it through the Apple App Store or Google Play, cancel or request a refund with that store.
steps: Sign in and open Services & subscriptions.
Choose Manage next to the subscription.

extra.intent: Using the Microsoft website, find the yearly price of Microsoft 365 Family in the United States. Do not change your plan or make a payment.
Your neighbor gave you a Microsoft 365 renewal card. Using the Microsoft help pages, find how many characters a Microsoft 365 product key has. Do not change anything on the account.
